title: Spex Machina Task Journal Line
description: Schema for one line of the task journal linking spec nodes to tasks, indifferent to where the journal file lives. Each line is a self-contained object: a change event, the registered event that opens a proposal's lifecycle, a task receipt, or a refresh receipt. There is no envelope, no counter, and no integer id anywhere in the format.

formatVersion.description: The journal-line format version, metadata outside any hashed payload. Absent means version 1, so no existing line changes meaning; a writer stamps the current version. The schema pins no upper bound — readers accept every version from 1 forward, forever, because the journal is append-only and permanent.

registeredEvent.description: Opens a proposal's lifecycle before any spec change exists.

eid.description: This event's own id, of the form <git_head>:<slug>.

proposal.description: The proposal slug this registration opens.

changeEvent.description: Records what a baselining absorbed for one spec node.

eid.description: The event's own id, deriving from (git_head, op_id).

node.description: The changed node's identity hash — the same key the merkle tree files that node's leaf under.

node_type.description: The kind of node this change event describes, as a type-name-shaped string — not a compiled-in enumeration. Which names are admissible is the resolved profile's declaration, checked at the write boundary by ingest's JournalEncoder before the append commits; the schema only fixes the field's shape.

before.description: The content leaf's hash before the change, or null — an add has no before.

after.description: The content leaf's hash after the change, or null — a removal has no after.

proposal.description: The proposal slug that produced this event.

path.description: The node's content-leaf path. Present when the node has one; absent for requirement and api events.

taskReceipt.description: Records what the tracker did in response to a change event or a proposal epic.

for.description: The eid this receipt answers — a change event's eid, or, for epics, the registered event's eid.

proposal.description: The proposal slug this epic receipt answers.

taskRetargetedReceipt.description: Records a task whose target moved to a new state without lifecycle. Takes the strict shape only — no task_retargeted line predates the for field, so the legacy proposal-slug arm belongs to task_created alone.

for.description: The eid of the retarget's own modified event.

refreshReceipt.description: Records a refresh run absorbing no-bead-work drift.

git_head.description: The git head the refresh ran at, admitting recorded absence.

absorbed.description: The eids of the change events this refresh absorbed. Empty when the refresh absorbed nothing, though a no-drift run appends nothing at all.
